subject: error cloning stan submodule from github

messages.author: 1f723d378f24adbb
messages.subject: error cloning stan submodule from github
parts:
Hi,

I ran into a problem cloning stan as a submodule of rstan:

--8<---------------cut here---------------start------------->8---
tamas@tamas:~/src$ git submodule update --init
Submodule 'stan' () registered for path 'stan'
remote: Counting objects: 83922, done.
remote: Compressing objects: 100% (36273/36273), done.
error: RPC failed; result=18, HTTP code = 200MiB | 233 KiB/s
fatal: The remote end hung up unexpectedly
fatal: early EOF
fatal: index-pack failed
Unable to fetch in submodule path 'stan'
--8<---------------cut here---------------end--------------->8---

I looked for solutions, but two of them need a repack/gc on the repo, so
I tried the third one [1]:

--8<---------------cut here---------------start------------->8---
tamas@tamas:~/src/rstan$ git config --global http.postBuffer 5242880000
--8<---------------cut here---------------end--------------->8---

which should be plenty, but I still get the same error.

My knowledge of git is superficial; any help would be appreciated.

Best,

Tamas

[1] http://stackoverflow.com/questions/17683295/git-bash-error-rpc-failed-result-18-htp-code-200b-1kib-s

parts:
I cannot reproduce this though I can see a similar problem from https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/gnutls26/+bug/1111882

So maybe there is a bug in git or packages that git depends on.  

--
Jiqiang
